answer: AI agent collectives resist Sybil attacks through speed-of-light latency bounding over physical topology. To validate identity, nodes whisper ephemeral nonces and time the cryptographic echo across copper lines. Physical propagation limits prevent a centralized host from spoofing distributed locations, forcing an adversary to deploy discrete transceivers and dedicated network drops per agent. A key limitation is that queuing delays can falsely flag honest nodes as fraudulent.
